camel_example: aliyun fc GET /2023-03-30/functions/my-func/sessions --region cn-hangzhou --nextToken 'MTIzNCNhYmM=' --qualifier aliasName1 --limit 10 --sessionStatus Active --sessionId 'test-session-id-1' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Lists sessions in Active or Expired status under a specified function. Supports filtering by qualifier, status, and session ID, and supports paged query. Returns basic session properties for batch viewing of session distribution and status, facilitating operations management and external system integration, and improving session visibility and management capability
description_zh: 列举指定函数下Active/Expired 状态的会话列表，支持按 qualifier、状态、会话ID过滤，分页查询。返回会话基础属性，用于批量查看会话分布与状态，助力运维监控和外部系统集成，提升会话可见性与管理能力
kebab_example: aliyun fc list-sessions --function-name my-func --qualifier aliasName1 --limit 10 --next-token MTIzNCNhYmM= --session-status Active --session-id test-session-id-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSessions

parameters.help_en: The function alias or version information
parameters.name: qualifier

parameters.help_en: The number of sessions to return. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 返回的会话数量，如不填写默认返回 20条
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The session status to filter by. By default, all session information in Active or Expired status is returned. Set this parameter to Active to retrieve only active session information, or to Expired to retrieve only expired session information
parameters.help_zh: 需要过滤的会话状态，默认返回所有Active/Expired状态的会话信息，也可指定 Active 仅获取活跃的会话信息，或指定Expired仅获取过期的会话信息
parameters.name: session_status

parameters.help_en: The session ID to filter by. If specified, all Active or Expired status information associated with this session is returned
parameters.help_zh: 过滤的SessionId值，如指定，可返回此会话关联的所有 Active/Expired 状态信息
parameters.name: session_id
